title: athyrium × shiibaense
intro: Athyrium × shiibaense, commonly known as Shiiba Lady Fern, is a hybrid fern species native to Japan. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Shiiba Lady Fern are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and free-radical scavenging activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects, and it is not recommended to use it as a treatment without consulting a healthcare professional.
